hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-extent, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Geometry.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/raster/extent to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/extent, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/extent/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

processDescription: in processDescription.inherited.json, each input and output that has a data type now names its representations (representation), the df:Representation items of bblocks-data-formats that realize that data type in a format the deployment declares (decision of 2026-11-18). Classified substantive: the form in which a part of the entry is stated changes.

definition: Build a vector data containing the image envelope polygon. Useful for some projection, you can set the polygon with more points with the sr parameter. This filter supports user-specified output projection. If no projection is defined, the standard WGS84 projection will be used.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: No openEO process computes the bounding envelope of a raster/data cube in the published bblocks-openeo register (filter_bbox takes a bbox as input to filter by, it does not compute one as output).
